status: demonstration written by engineering from dated public sources and the pilot's records; no experiment has run and no benefit is realized or claimed
shape_note: Candidate fields follow the local AgentBriefs prototype (design/prototypes/agentbriefs): id, title, kind, label and ready. This is a demonstration record, not a registered contract.
evidence_floor: A candidate is offered only with at least one dated source and an experiment with a baseline, a metric and an acceptance rule. Anything else is withheld with its reason and raises no alert.

observations.fact: CI at v7.2.2 runs Python 3.10 to 3.15, 3.13t, 3.14t, 3.15t, PyPy 3.10 and 3.11

7.1.5 (2026-07-23) fixed TLRUCache keeping stale values on expired overwrites; 7.1.7 (2026-08-01) improved Cache.__setitem__ on larger replacements; 7.2.2 (2026-10-15) improved TTLCache when computing expiration fails
four pilot regenerations of TLRUCache each passed 31 of 34 held-out tests and failed test_ttu, test_ttu_expired and test_ttu_reverse_insert
an AI-assisted review record dated 2026-10-15 and Copilot instructions are in the repository

candidates.title: Stateful property tests for the timed caches
candidates.label: Experimental fit

evidence.fact: Hypothesis 6.170.0, MPL-2.0, provides rule-based stateful testing
three cache bookkeeping fixes in three months

estimated_benefit.statement: a model-based test with a fake timer would have found the 7.1.5 stale-value bug and may find similar faults before release

experiment.treatment: one RuleBasedStateMachine against a dictionary-plus-expiry reference
experiment.acceptance: finds the stale-value failure on v7.1.4 and nothing on v7.2.2 within 2,000 examples and 60 seconds

candidates.title: State that time-to-use values can expire out of insertion order
candidates.label: Experimental fit

evidence.fact: all four pilot runs reused TTLCache's insertion-ordered list and failed the same three out-of-order and already-expired tests
the TLRUCache documentation does not state out-of-order expiry or the already-expired insertion case

estimated_benefit.statement: one documented sentence and one doctest would stop the same misreading by people and coding agents

experiment.baseline: pilot task a, current documentation, prompt without the pointer to TTLCache, six runs
experiment.treatment: the same with the added sentence, six runs
experiment.metric: runs that pass the three tests
experiment.acceptance: at least four of six with the sentence and at most one of six without it
experiment.effects: about 12 harness runs within a recorded model allowance
experiment.rights: documentation change proposed upstream only by the maintainers' process
